For children 1 month and older the BNFC suggests a dose of 5 mg/kg once dai- ly for 6 months when used alone or for 3 months when given with rifampicin; WHO recommends 5 mg/kg once daily for 6 months. For daily dosing regimens the maximum oral dose of isoniazid is 300 mg and for intermittent regimens the maximum dose is 900 mg per dose.
